org.portico.lrc.services.saverestore.data

Interface SaveRestoreTarget

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    Federation, InterestManager, LRCMessageQueue, LRCState, MomManager, OwnershipManager, RegionStore, Repository, SyncPointManager, TimeManager

    public interface SaveRestoreTarget
    Any component that needs to participate in the save/restore process must implement this interface. The two methods allow each component to control what part of their state is saved and to do any pre- or post-save/restore setup or cleanup.

    Additionally, any component that wants to be included in a save/restore set much register itself with the Serializer, otherwise it won't
